## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for every changed behaviour
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` line under `## [Unreleased]` (or not user-visible)
- [ ] Docs updated: `docs/user` and/or `docs/dev` (or not needed)
- [ ] ADR added for a structural decision (or none taken)
- [ ] New dependencies justified below: why, health, license (or none)
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` and `.ia/skills` still true after this change
- [ ] No secret, commented-out code or `TODO` without an issue number
